items.q: What events do you cater for?
items.a: Weddings, birthdays, college fests, corporate events, festivals, markets and private parties – if there are thirsty guests, we'll be there.

items.q: Where do you provide your service?
items.a: We are based in Sutton and serve all of London and Surrey. For events further away just ask – we travel.

items.q: Can I book The CaneHouse for a wedding?
items.a: Absolutely. We set up our vintage stall and press fresh juice live for your guests. Send us your date and guest count for a quote.

items.q: Do you provide custom event packages?
items.a: Yes. Packages are tailored to your guest numbers, flavours, serving hours and budget.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: For weekends and weddings we recommend 4–8 weeks. Smaller orders can often be arranged within a few days.

items.q: Can I order sugarcane juice online?
items.a: Yes – place an order through our enquiry form, phone or WhatsApp for home delivery and bulk orders.

items.q: Do you offer franchise opportunities?
items.a: Yes. We offer kiosk, event, community and mobile cart franchise models with full training and support.

items.q: Where can I make an enquiry?
items.a: Use the enquiry form on our Contact page, call +44 777 046 1939 or message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: Is sugarcane juice safe for diabetics?
items.a: Sugarcane juice is naturally sweet and contains natural sugars, so people with diabetes should enjoy it only in moderation and after speaking with their doctor.

items.q: Does sugarcane juice have calories?
items.a: Yes. Sugarcane juice contains naturally occurring sugars, so it does contain calories. Please ask us if you would like more detail.

items.q: How is your juice different?
items.a: We press premium cane fresh in front of you with nothing added – no sugar, water, colours or preservatives – just pure cane.

items.q: Is your juice 100% natural?
items.a: Yes. Our juice is 100% natural. Flavours like lemon, ginger and mint are added fresh.

items.q: How should I store it?
items.a: Fresh cane juice is best enjoyed straight away. If needed, refrigerate in a sealed bottle and drink within 24 hours.

items.q: What kinds of events do you cater for?
items.a: Weddings, birthdays, college fests, corporate events, festivals, markets and private parties – if there are thirsty guests, we can be there.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: For weekends and weddings we recommend 4–8 weeks. Smaller events can often be arranged within a few days – just ask.

items.q: Which areas do you cover?
items.a: We are based in Sutton and serve London and Surrey. For events further away, send us the location and we will let you know.

items.q: Do you press the juice live at the event?
items.a: Yes. We set up our vintage stall and press fresh sugarcane live in front of your guests – it is part of the show.

items.q: Can the package be tailored to my event?
items.a: Yes. Packages are built around your guest numbers, flavours, serving hours and budget.

items.q: What do you need from the venue?
items.a: Usually a flat space for the stall and access to a power point. Tell us about your venue when you enquire and we will confirm what we need.

items.q: Are you insured and food-safety trained?
items.a: Yes. Through NCASS we have public & product liability insurance, a documented food safety system and food hygiene training.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Send us your date, location and guest count using the enquiry form on this page, or call or WhatsApp us.

items.q: What franchise models do you offer?
items.a: There are four: City Kiosk, Event Franchise, Community Outlet and Mobile Cart. We will help you choose the one that suits your area and plans.

items.q: Do I need experience in food or drinks?
items.a: No. We train you in pressing, serving, hygiene and running the stall day to day.

items.q: What training and support do I get?
items.a: Full training before you open, plus marketing support and ongoing guidance once you are trading.

items.q: How much does it cost to start?
items.a: It depends on the model and location. Send us an application and we will share the full details with you.

items.q: Where can I open a franchise?
items.a: Tell us the area you have in mind in your application and we will talk through whether it is a good fit.

items.q: Can I open a sugarcane juice franchise in London?
items.a: Yes. We are based in Sutton, London, and welcome applications from London and the rest of the UK. Tell us the area you have in mind and we will talk it through with you.

items.q: Can a franchise offer event juice catering?
items.a: Yes. The Event Franchise model is built for fairs, festivals, weddings and corporate days, pressing fresh sugarcane juice in front of guests.

items.q: Will I use The CaneHouse name and stall style?
items.a: Yes. Partners trade as The CaneHouse with our vintage look, recipes and way of serving fresh cane juice.

items.q: How do I apply?
items.a: Fill in the franchise application form on this page. We will get back to you to arrange a chat.
